Context: 5. Relaxations.-

- (iii) Procedure.Conditions in the recruitment from ban orders on filling up of vacant posts.
6. Limitations.Compassionate appointments can be made only up to 5% of direct recruitment vacancies which may be calculated on the basis of total direct recruitment vacancies for Groups 'C' posts (including technical posts) that have arisen in the year. No compassionate appointment can be made if there is no vacancy.
